raw_line: A medium shot frames a moss-covered stone in a sun-dappled forest clearing, where a single golden leaf spirals slowly from the upper left branch, its veins catching the dappled light as it descends toward the center. The camera remains completely static while the background foliage shifts imperceptibly in the breeze, creating a living tapestry of green and amber hues that contrasts with the sharp focus on the falling leaf. As the leaf settles onto the rough, wet surface of the stone, concentric ripples expand outward across a shallow pool of water at the base, distorting the reflection of the surrounding trees. The sound of dry leaves rustling in the wind blends with the soft, rhythmic lap of water against the rock, establishing a serene auditory backdrop. A second, smaller leaf drifts into the frame from the right edge, joining the first on the stone before both are caught in the gentle current of the rippling water. slow dolly-in

segments_zh: 中景镜头在阳光斑驳的森林空地上拍摄了一块长满青苔的石头，一片金色的叶子从左上方的树枝上慢慢盘旋，当它向中心下降时，它的叶脉捕捉到斑驳的光线。相机保持完全静止，而背景树叶在微风中不知不觉地变化，创造出一幅绿色和琥珀色的生动挂毯，与落叶上的锐利焦点形成鲜明对比。
当叶子落到粗糙潮湿的石头表面上时，同心波纹会在底部的浅水池上向外扩展，扭曲周围树木的倒影。
干树叶在风中沙沙作响的声音与柔和而有节奏的水拍打岩石的声音融为一体，营造出宁静的听觉背景。
第二片较小的叶子从右边缘飘入框架，与石头上的第一片叶子相连，然后它们都被卷入涟漪的水流中。缓慢推入
